name: DFRobot SEN0526 Fermion I2S MEMS Microphone (Breakout)
//: True of DFRobot SEN0526, schematic Rev V1.0, PCB SEN0526 [V0.0.3] (2022-08-08, dimension drawing v1.0): MEMSensing MSM261S4030H0R, 6 through-holes in one row, two 2 mm mounting holes. Other MSM261 or INMP441 breakouts share the I2S idea, not this pin order. verified: true = the maker's text at the cited page; read off the schematic or the dimension drawing = false.

needs.note: tri-stated outside its channel; a 100k pull-down on the module discharges it

power.note: 3.3 V only: no regulator on the module, chip absolute max 4.0 V

NOT a supply: a strap. SEL low selects the LEFT I2S channel and the module has no pull on it, so the board ties it to ground. Tie it to 3V3 instead for the right channel (a second mic on the same bus).

host_requirements: Feed 3V3 from the 3.3 V rail only: the module has no regulator and the chip's absolute maximum is 4.0 V, so 5 V on the 3V3 pad destroys the microphone.

Wire by the silkscreen, not by the wiki's pinout table: the table lists 3V3, GND, SCK, SEL, WS, DO, but the pads run GND, 3V3, WS, SEL, SCK, DO (mic up, holes at the bottom). Wiring the first two by the table swaps 3V3 and GND.
SEL floats on this module: tie it to GND (left channel, as this record wires it) or to 3V3 (right channel). The firmware must read the same channel, or it records silence.
The ESP32 I2S must give SCK = 64 x WS with SCK between 1.0 and 4.0 MHz (about 16 to 62 kHz sample rate) and read 32-bit slots: the data is 24 bits in a 32-bit word.
The microphone is always on (CHIPEN tied to 3V3, about 0.75-1 mA): to stop it drawing in deep sleep, switch its supply.
The sound port is on top of the mic can (top-ported, the component side): face that side to the enclosure's opening.

sen0526-i2s-mems-microphone-datasheet-v1.title: MSM261S4030H0R I2S digital output MEMS microphone with Multi-modes

pin_order_proof.source: read from two DFRobot drawings that agree: the schematic Rev V1.0 numbers header P1 1 DOUT, 2 BCLK, 3 SEL, 4 WS, 5 VCC, 6 GND; the dimension drawing v1.0 shows the silkscreen left to right GND 3V3 WS SEL SCK DO (mic up, holes at the bottom edge), i.e. pad 6..1. The wiki's pinout TABLE lists another order (3V3 GND SCK SEL WS DO) - not the pad order. Confirm against the module's silkscreen. A third agrees: the schematic PDF's page 2 copper print (PCB 'SEN0526 [V0.0.3]') shows the end pad beside the left mounting hole tied to the ground pour with thermal spokes.
